name: Stereotaxic frame
purpose: Represent precise spatial positioning in anatomy models.
geometryBrief: Base, orthogonal arms, scales, holders and probe mount.
behaviorBrief: Coordinate placement and transforms; no surgical approach guidance.
inputs: Digital anatomy coordinate frame, stage-axis calibration, mount pose and virtual point
outputs: Probe pose and landmark coordinates with parent frame and transform provenance
acceptance: Use an asymmetric landmark triad and known rigid transform. Transform each point to stage coordinates and back within numeric tolerance; left and right labels must remain distinct.
geometryStatus: Built, documentary solid profile with known exterior plate scale
simulationStatus: Detached triangle illustration; no positioning model
related: Exterior references and independent static artwork checks

name: Surgical stereo microscope
purpose: Magnified inspection and placement of devices in virtual anatomy.
geometryBrief: Stand, zoom optics, illumination, camera and focus.
behaviorBrief: Navigate specimen and position an implant with scale; virtual only.
inputs: Scaled virtual specimen, camera calibration, zoom state and implant pose
outputs: Inspection view and annotated positions/distances in specimen coordinates
acceptance: Measure a synthetic 1 mm fiducial at two zoom levels. Its pixel separation should change with zoom while calibrated physical distance remains 1 mm within rounding.
geometryStatus: Nikon motorized SMZ25 documented metric exterior
simulationStatus: Dormant instrument and independent fixed-chart scaling
integrationStatus: Standalone viewer; no specimen, optical or hardware link

name: Gait analysis
purpose: Quantify model or recorded gait recovery after nerve injury.
geometryBrief: Glass walkway, enclosure, adjustable corridor, LED rail, camera and goal box; 130 x 68 x 152 cm overall.
behaviorBrief: Footfall and gait metrics from simulated trajectories or real recorded datasets.
inputs: Timestamped paw-contact masks, paw identity and calibrated walkway coordinates
outputs: Footfall table with contact intervals, stance durations and same-paw stride lengths
acceptance: Replay two same-paw contacts 30 mm apart, each lasting 0.1 s. Recover the two stance intervals and one 30 mm stride within sampling resolution.
geometryStatus: First pass: stationary CatWalk XT 10.7 exterior, documented frame envelope verified
simulationStatus: First pass: unrelated abstract polygon mark inspection; original gait acceptance deferred
integrationStatus: First pass: simulator route, editable GLB, passive named XR action and JSON example

name: Behavior tracking
purpose: Analyze locomotion and movement from reference videos.
geometryBrief: Arena, camera mount and monitor, custom enclosure.
behaviorBrief: Trajectory, velocity and event analysis with provenance.
inputs: Timestamped video or planar trajectory, spatial calibration, tracking mask and arena regions
outputs: Position and speed series, zone entries, dwell time and missing-detection flags
acceptance: Replay a marker moving at constant known speed across one zone boundary. Recover one entry and the prescribed speed to pixel/time resolution, with an inserted occlusion marked missing.
geometryStatus: Original metric illustrative PC desk and monitor, not Noldus hardware
simulationStatus: Verified fixed nonbiological geometric waypoint inspection and missing-data gaps; no video, tracking, acquisition or behavior analysis
integrationStatus: Interactive 3D/2D illustration, authored CSV and JSON export; browser and headset verification pending

name: Preclinical MRI
model: Bruker BioSpec 70/30 USR V2 (30 cm bare-bore reference)
purpose: Visualize anatomical context and longitudinal datasets.
geometryBrief: Magnet cylinder, bore, patient/specimen table, RF coils, console and racks.
behaviorBrief: Load registered MRI volumes; optional simplified signal model. MRI safety cannot be inferred from appearance.
inputs: Registered MRI volume, voxel-to-world affine, modality metadata and implant pose
outputs: Anatomical sections and registered overlays with source volume and physical coordinates
acceptance: Load an asymmetric labeled volume with anisotropic voxels and a known orientation. A fiducial overlay must meet its landmark within one voxel on all three section views.

name: Micro-CT scanner
purpose: Visualize bone and implants including cochlear anatomy.
geometryBrief: Shielded scanner, rotating specimen/support and operator console.
behaviorBrief: Volume viewing, implant registration and artifact labeling.
inputs: CT volume with voxel scale, implant geometry, registration transform and artifact mask
outputs: Registered anatomy/implant volume, world-space distances and labeled artifact regions
acceptance: Register a digital array to a bead phantom of known spacing. Recover spacing to voxel resolution and preserve a supplied streak mask independently of the implant label.
geometryStatus: Closed catalogue-sized 1276 CMOS exterior; no mechanisms
simulationStatus: Detached synthetic shape and annotation archive; no scanning or registration
integrationStatus: Dedicated simulator, editable asset and example exports linked

name: High-frequency ultrasound
model: FUJIFILM VisualSonics Vevo 3100 (legacy LAZR-X console exterior)
purpose: Represent tissue imaging and perfusion research.
geometryBrief: Console, probe, articulated arm, sample platform and cables.
behaviorBrief: Display reference or modeled ultrasound images with calibrated transducer settings.
inputs: Calibrated B-mode image or synthetic echo frame, transducer preset and depth sampling
outputs: Ultrasound image, depth localization and acquisition metadata
acceptance: Supply two axial reflectors at known depths in a synthetic frame. The ruler must recover their separation to within one axial sample under the declared calibration.
simulationStatus: Detached static graphic ruler; no acquisition or exposure
related: Cart references and independent ruler checks

name: Functional ultrasound
geometryBrief: Scanner console, transducer mount, probe and acquisition display.
behaviorBrief: Reference Doppler/functional maps; hemodynamics is not direct neural activity.
inputs: Time-indexed power Doppler images, baseline window, ROI mask and experiment event times
outputs: Relative power Doppler time course and hemodynamic change map aligned to events
acceptance: Step one phantom ROI from 100 to 110 power units while a control ROI stays flat. Its baseline-relative map should show +10% in the first and zero in the control.
geometryStatus: Photograph-evidenced closed Iconeus One lower cart only, using explicitly assumed dimensional datum
simulationStatus: Independent authored width comparison verified; no physical, imaging, acquisition or biological model
integrationStatus: Dormant metric GLB, detached view controls and JSON export; browser and headset verification pending

name: Optical bioluminescence imager
purpose: Represent longitudinal optical imaging of labeled samples.
geometryBrief: Dark chamber, specimen bed, camera housing and computer.
behaviorBrief: Signal visualization, attenuation and calibration metadata.
inputs: Calibrated emission frames, dark reference, exposure duration, ROI and attenuation metadata
outputs: Background-corrected optical signal and longitudinal ROI series with calibration provenance
acceptance: In the linear unsaturated range, double source counts and exposure time together. The dark-corrected counts per second must agree across both frames.
geometryStatus: First pass: stationary classic IVIS Spectrum non-CT exterior; nominal cabinet dimensions verified
simulationStatus: First pass: detached fixed grayscale-code examples only; original imaging acceptance deferred
integrationStatus: First pass: simulator route, editable GLB, passive named XR action and digital pattern exports

name: Retinal OCT
purpose: Inspect retinal layers and implant position.
geometryBrief: Handheld or mounted scan head, stage and console; verify exact setup.
behaviorBrief: Cross-sectional OCT images and layer thickness, with dataset provenance.
inputs: OCT B-scan, axial tissue-distance calibration, retinal boundaries and implant annotations
outputs: Layer thickness profile, annotated cross section and implant-to-layer offsets
acceptance: Supply two parallel boundaries five pixels apart on a scan calibrated to 4 µm per axial pixel in tissue. Recover 20 µm across valid columns and flag missing boundaries.
geometryStatus: Source-grounded inactive metric cart and sealed head exterior
simulationStatus: Dormant exhibit and detached graphic scale with missing-mark guard
integrationStatus: Standalone viewer; no optics, clinical data or hardware linkage

name: Retinal electrophysiology
purpose: Represent ERG and controlled visual stimulation.
geometryBrief: Console, Ganzfeld dome, electrodes and display.
behaviorBrief: Simulated or recorded ERG traces, stimulus timing and retinal model response.
inputs: Recorded or modeled ERG epochs, flash timing, voltage calibration and baseline window
outputs: Event-aligned ERG average, trough/peak amplitudes and implicit times
acceptance: Replay clean synthetic epochs with a known negative trough and a later positive peak. Recover their times relative to the flash within one sample and amplitudes under the selected baseline convention.

name: Auditory electrophysiology
purpose: Assess auditory responses relevant to cochlear research.
geometryBrief: RZ6 rack, preamp, speaker, acoustic enclosure, headstage and calibration microphone.
behaviorBrief: Stimulus timing, ABR traces, thresholds and noise using reference/model data.
inputs: Stimulus level and trigger times, calibrated auditory response epochs, peak windows and detection rule
outputs: Averaged ABR traces, latency estimates and rule-defined threshold with stimulus units
acceptance: Create a noise-free level series with a fixed-latency peak appearing only above a known test level. The detector should select the first positive level and recover latency within one sample.
geometryStatus: Built, documented rack face and estimated disconnected cases
simulationStatus: Verified offline synthetic peak index; no stimulation or acquisition
integrationStatus: Standalone exhibit and fixed-file trace JSON/CSV
related: Case geometry references and offline verification

name: Cochlear implant research interface
model: Custom electrode array and auditory stimulation bench
purpose: Compare implant geometry and predicted auditory nerve recruitment.
geometryBrief: Cochlear anatomy section, electrode carrier, connector and current source.
behaviorBrief: Field/axon coupling and tonotopic coverage; no guarantee of perceptual outcome.
inputs: Cochlear array geometry, conductive medium, pulse events, auditory fiber positions and place–frequency map
outputs: Per-fiber extracellular voltage and modeled recruitment indexed by cochlear place and frequency
acceptance: In an ideal homogeneous point-source fixture, compare voltage at two known distances with the analytic 1/r ratio. A zero-current trial must reproduce the unstimulated model baseline.
geometryStatus: Unbuilt closed-enclosure study and separate gauge
simulationStatus: Passive geometric fit only; research workflow not represented
integrationStatus: Documentary exterior and geometric fit export wired

name: Retinal prosthesis bench
model: Custom photovoltaic/electrical retinal implant test platform
purpose: Compare electrical and optical retinal prosthesis designs.
geometryBrief: Retinal model, implant holder, projection source and recording array.
behaviorBrief: Local field or photon model, retinal cell response and simulated visual representation with limitations.
inputs: Retinal layer geometry, implant pose, pixel illumination or current map and response model
outputs: Layer-indexed drive and model response maps, registered to implant pixels
acceptance: Illuminate one pixel in a symmetric synthetic phantom, then mirror the input. The drive map must mirror accordingly; a zero-drive control must reproduce the unstimulated baseline.
geometryStatus: Original unbuilt inert cabinet concept, not physical hardware; independent authored metric gauge
simulationStatus: Verified detached dry geometric clearances only; no retinal, electrical, optical, or operating model
integrationStatus: Metric GLB, 3D/2D gauge viewer and JSON export; browser and headset verification pending
